observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token.txt)
echo '=== qgis-server /projects ==='
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec qgis-server ls -la /projects/ 2>&1
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec qgis-server ls -la /projects/*/ 2>&1 | head
echo '=== WMS GetCapabilities with MAP=test-project ==='
curl -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities&MAP=/projects/test-project.qgz" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /tmp/wms_caps2.xml -w 'HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n'
head -c 400 /tmp/wms_caps2.xml; echo
